See attached (ROTATING_SLOTS_ACME_v1.pdf) and the quick options below (all times shown with common conversions).

Proposed rotating slots (examples for Week A — we'll rotate the pattern Week B):
- Option A1: Tue 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 GMT (US morning / EU evening)
- Option A2: Wed 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET / 16:30 GMT (US early / EU afternoon)
- Option A3: Thu 22:00 PT / Fri 01:00 ET / Fri 06:00 GMT / Sat 14:00 AEST (APAC-friendly — alternate weeks)

If you prefer, we can pick two recurring slots and rotate Aditya and Marissa through them. Please reply with which of the three options works best for your team, and if you'd like us to always hold the APAC option (we can make that optional).

Proposed attendees from our side: Aditya Rao (Solutions Eng) and Marissa Cole (AE).
